recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No additional core source change is needed for FHIR-23009.
issue_request: FHIR-23009 asked PA to clarify that Patient.link can point to RelatedPerson, matching existing structure and examples, rather than being limited to other Patient resources.
initial_application: Git commit 0c1f77f6446d5ba97a2a8e3153f1b9ab78c49f56 applied the issue by changing Patient.link.short and Patient.link.definition to include RelatedPerson.
additional_context: FHIR-32874 later corrected the wording introduced by FHIR-23009; FHIR-34329 changed person to individual; FHIR-34156 aligned Patient.link.other.definition; FHIR-41559 later clarified RelatedPerson narrative after a Patient.link implementer question.
reconciliation: No source change was made because current Patient source keeps Patient.link and Patient.link.other inclusive of Patient and RelatedPerson, and RelatedPerson source now explains the same-individual use case.
